name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: The 1442-rated player and the 1342-rated player are in different study groups.
The player with the Rosewood set's rating is at least 100 more than the Caro-Kann player.
The player who loves the Pin's rating is immediately next to the player with the Boxwood set.

The 1392-rated player does not belong to the King's-Pawn Camp.
The player with the Marble set's rating is immediately below Anatoly.
The player who loves the Zugzwang's rating is higher than both Nadia and the Slav player.
